description: This file contains functions for installing Google Maps related custom fields and logic hooks within a SuiteCRM module, including registration of hooks for various modules such as Prospects, Leads, Contacts, Meetings, Opportunities, Cases, Projects, and Accounts, along with a function to define custom fields.

methods.name: install_gmaps
methods.description: Initializes the installation process by requiring the ModuleInstaller class, installing custom fields, and setting up hooks.

methods.name: installJJWHooks
methods.description: Defines and registers logic hooks for various modules such as Prospects, Leads, Contacts, Meetings, Opportunities, Cases, Projects, and Accounts.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Returns an array defining custom geographic coordinate and geocode status fields for multiple modules including Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Meetings, Opportunities, Cases, Projects, and Prospects.
